notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone playing Tanpopo Planet. [/p][p]Thank you very much to everyone who is interested in our game.[/p][p]This is Mareffy, the creator.[/p][p]This game has been officially released.[/p][p]We plan to continue updating the game as we see fit.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]Update Details[/p][p]・Added voice acting throughout the game.[/p][p]Cast[/p][p]Nerf and others: Togano Shuu[/p][p]Shou and others: COEIROINK: Tsukuyomi-chan  [/p][p]Doo and others: COEIROINK: Kuro Satoshi Utsuki  [/p][p]Bora: COEIROINK: Merciful=Martha  [/p][p]• Added a few new illustrations (still images)  [/p][p]• Adjusted the fortune-telling feature so it can be viewed outside the game  [/p][p]• Adjusted some text and added short text in various places[/p][p]• Made the Nars doll an item starting from the second one[/p][p]• Adjusted the specifications of the juices provided by the juice shop[/p][p]• Made minor adjustments to the BGM[/p][p]• Added an image song[/p][p]• Changed the frame[/p][p]• Made Mac-compatible[/p][p]• Fixed bugs[/p][p]• Adjusted some end sequences and other elements[/p][p]• Made minor adjustments to UI, sound effects, and the placement of falling objects, etc.[/p]

notes.title: Status of Dandelion Planet Development and Press Release0720
notes.notes: [p]Hello to everyone who plays Dandelion Planet, thank you for your interest. I am the author.[/p][p]I have resumed development on a new PC.[/p][p]We are currently working on [/p][p]・Mac version support [/p][p]・Juice shop specification adjustment (easier to get L) [/p][p]・Addition of pictures [/p][p]・Addition of part voices [/p][p]・Bug fixes [/p][p]・Other small adjustments [/p][p]etc. We are aiming for a press release on [/p][p]July 27.[/p][p]Thank you in advance for your cooperation.[/p]

Hello

notes.title: Status of Dandelion Planet Development
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760812/d756e80087d8b004e03f0980c596fda0b107c598.png[/img]
Good afternoon to all of you who have been playing Dandelion Planet.
To all of you who have been playing Dandelion Planet
For those of you who are interested in us.
Thank you very much for your interest. I am the author.

What I'm doing now is increasing the number of EDs.
At the beginning of development, I was planning to have 3 EDs in total.
However, when I looked at the playing of the people who are playing the game
I thought it would end too soon, so I increased the number to 7 or 8.
We have increased the number of EDs to 7 or 8.
Now we have 6 in the works.

We are also planning to add one more character.
I'm working on that one right now, with the standing picture and the first event already implemented and the plot ready.

We will need a little more time for development.
Please wait a little longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760812/dae700ddfa422d8ec6718b67d90e3b17de4b63cf.png[/img]

notes.title: Dandelion Planet Early Access Version 1.5 has been updated!
notes.notes:
Dandelion Planet Early Access Version 1.5 has been updated!

Update Contents
[list]
[*] Gender selection for siblings was added.
[*] You can now spend 30 days.
[*] Added two new EDs.
[*] "Astronomical Observation" and "Festival Day" special events have been added.
[*] The back side of the main room can now be examined.
[*] Revised screen design.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[*] The display mode can now be switched on the title screen.
[/list]
